evidence.note: The swarm is drawn as dozens of 1 px pale grey connector lines fanning into the package mirror, ending in small outlined dots a few pixels across.
At the small viewer size the swarm lines become a dense web of hairlines, and the agent dots and stacked folder outlines are tiny thin-stroke shapes that compression would smear.
The 'PUBLIC INTERNET' zone label is very pale grey on near-white, and the globe and arrow use thin light strokes. The folder and file icons are thin outline drawings.
The 'PUBLIC INTERNET' label is small and faint. The lock and eye badges are small.
The title, timeline text, quote cards and legend are large and high contrast. They would survive compression.

rationale: Text outside the diagram is generous and legible, but the central swarm diagram is built from many 1 px pale hairlines and tiny thin-outlined dots. These are what the fail anchor describes and would be erased by compression, especially at 1288x598. The faint small 'PUBLIC INTERNET' label adds small low-contrast text.
